data: All 37 previously frozen controlled requests, all five originally compared methods
purpose: Audit review-option reduction against correctness and availability guardrails without selecting subgroups for favorable outcomes.
known_prior_evidence: The published full-cohort means and older unadjusted paired intervals were already inspected. This is an explicit post-hoc uncertainty and mechanism audit, not a prospectively registered confirmatory experiment.
primary_audit_contrast: HPID Group IDs minus DBSCAN review_option_count over all 37 requests; also show all other original methods.
option_rule: If any exported identity matches the normalized semantic request, expose those semantic matches; otherwise expose all exported instances. Never interpret this count as measured human time.
metrics: any semantically correct target among matches at IoU .25/.50
any geometrically correct target in exposed options at IoU .25/.50
any geometrically correct target in all exported instances at IoU .25/.50
guardrail_interpretation: Correctness and candidate availability are shown with paired counts and intervals. Matching observed totals do not establish statistical equivalence or noninferiority. Geometric availability in a fallback set does not imply semantic resolution.
unit: Verify the 37 requests belong to 37 unique source images; if so paired case bootstrap. Otherwise source-image cluster bootstrap.
uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples, seed 20261009; descriptive 95% CIs for all metrics. Review-option comparisons against four original baselines additionally use 98.75% Bonferroni individual intervals for four-way familywise coverage. All metrics and effects remain visible.
secondary_subsets: Requests where both HPID and the comparator expose a semantically correct target at IoU .25 and .50
Requests where both methods expose a geometrically correct target in their actual review set at IoU .25 and .50
Requests where both methods have the same unique/ambiguous/unresolved state
subset_warning: These GT-conditioned post-hoc subsets are auxiliary mechanism diagnostics. They cannot replace the full cohort, establish causal cost reduction, or be called an independent confirmation.
freeze: No algorithm, semantic normalization, query target, request rule, candidate mask, parameter, or case exclusion is changed. No new timing experiment is run.
